'''Martos''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] helm [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After an Imperial boarding party ambushed and boarded [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] cruiser ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'', Martos piloted the ship to the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]].<ref name="TOR" />
